## Problem and change

Describe the problem and how this change addresses it. Link related issues.

## Validation

List the checks performed and their results. State any untested behavior or
hardware requirements. For documentation-only changes, note that explicitly.

## Checklist

- [ ] Repository content, code, comments, and UI text are in English.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Applicable checks have been run and actual results are recorded above.
- [ ] No credentials, private datasets, signing keys, or personal data are included.
- [ ] Third-party licensing and attribution are preserved, if applicable.
